description: GVRD sewer trunk mains is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This dataset consists of the GVRD (Metro Vancouver) trunk sewer mains. Related datasets include: Sanitary network (mains and manholes) Storm network (mains and manholes) Combined network (mains and manholes) City force mains (mains and manholes) GVRD (Metro Vancouver) trunk sewers (mains and manholes) Sewer catch basins The types of mains and manholes are distinguished by ... Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Water and sewer. Its keywords are sewer. The portal shows 1,657 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
